programme.title: Prey for the Devil
programme.desc: In response to a global rise in demonic possessions, The Roman Catholic Church opens schools to train priests to perform exorcisms. Though nuns are forbidden to perform this ritual, a professor recognizes Sister Ann's supernatural gifts and agrees to train her. Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, she soon finds herself in a battle for the soul of a young girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

programme.title: Faces Of Anne
programme.desc: Anne woke up alone on a mysterious island with no recollection of who she is or how she got there. The staff in the building she woke up in claims that she is in a hospital recovering from her amnesia. But there is something odd with how every girl she meets is named Anne and something sinister roams the building every night. Now, she must quickly figure out how to survive and escape from her predicament.

programme.title: The Boy Behind The Door
programme.desc: After Bobby and his best friend Kevin are kidnapped and taken to a strange house in the middle of nowhere, Bobby manages to escape. But as he starts to make a break for it, he hears Kevin's screams for help and realizes he can't leave his friend behind.

programme.title: Anguish
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Tess has suffered a pained past. She's been diagnosed with an assortment of mental ailments since her mother discovered her at a young age gruesomely banging her head against a wall. Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.

programme.title: Wolves on Savin Hill
programme.desc: Sahabat lama dari Boston berjauhan berikutan penemuan yang mengejutkan jauh di dalam hutan Bukit Savin. Selepas beberapa tahun, pembunuhan tragis menyatukan mereka semula.

programme.title: Midnight Horror
programme.desc: An aspiring flight attendant named Soo-hyeon agrees to a one-week part time job at a convenience store that pays suspiciously too well. What she initially thought would be easy money is nothing like she ever imagined as the strange customers and the mysterious store owner creates an unpredictable horror.

programme.title: Susuk
programme.desc: Imran is a good son to his mother. He takes care of his mother even though his mother has been behaving strangely ever since she fell sick. This had Imran thinking that his mother is possibly practicing a black magic called Susuk. Imran asks for advice from a religious man in the mosque to help him remove the Susuk.
